Try selecting this text to test selection rendering and damage tracking.

Instructions

With debug-render tool:

go run ./cmd/debug-render -overlay -profile testdata/render/debug-test.html

With test-render tool:

go run ./cmd/test-render -profile -iterations 10 testdata/render/debug-test.html

What to observe:

  • Hover over boxes → should see cyan hover rect, red damage rect
  • Click inputs → should see yellow focus rect
  • Select text → should see blue selection rect
  • Profile output → timing for style, layout, paint, damage stages
